SIPHUTHANDO MKHIZE — CIVIL ENGINEERING & REVIT PORTFOLIO

PROJECT 1 — ONE-WAY SLAB REINFORCEMENT
Reinforced concrete modelling and documentation, with three drawing exports:
a reinforced 3D model, a section, and a supporting frame elevation.
Project files include a design analysis workbook, reinforcement schedule,
material takeoff, bill of quantities, and native Revit model.
Analysis workbook parameters: 4 m clear span, 175 mm slab, 30 MPa concrete,
main Y12 bars at 200 mm and transverse Y10 bars at 300 mm.

PROJECT 2 — ONE-WAY SLAB REINFORCEMENT
A separate project entry with drawing views and supporting documentation.

DYNAMO DOCUMENTATION STUDY
A Revit Dynamo CPython 3 script exploring material reporting, view creation,
sheet placement, and combined PDF export for an existing silo model.
The workflow matrix maps fourteen stages across setup, modelling,
and documentation.

TECHNICAL AREAS
Revit, Dynamo, Python, reinforcement detailing, drawing production,
material takeoff, and sheet organisation.
